name: The Nam Rom and the basin fields
nameVi: Sông Nậm Rốm — lòng chảo Mường Thanh
kicker: The river and the rice under the hills
summary: Walk the Nậm Rốm through the ward and look at the rice the handbook sees from Đồi D1. This is the ground the 1954 battle sat in, not a ticketed park and not a tea plateau. A loop length was not printed. Check on arrival.
timeNeeded: A walk between the monument and the bridge
getThere: In the center of the basin ward. Minutes on foot are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The Nậm Rốm, the town bank, and the hills around the basin

notice.title: This basin is not a tea plateau
notice.body: The fields under the monument are the Mường Thanh basin. A tea-row photograph is Mộc Châu, further east on Highway 6. A prison-wall photograph is Sơn La.

body: The Nậm Rốm runs through the ward. You see it from the Mường Thanh bridge and from Phố đi bộ Mường Thanh, the walking street the city paper places beside the river in the new block. From Đồi D1 the 2021 handbook looks down on the city, the yellow rice, and the ridges. The national tourism desk calls Mường Thanh the largest basin in the Northwest. The walk is the ground between those points. It is not a ticketed park.

No ticket was printed on the pages read. Check on arrival only if a park gate appears. A loop length was not printed. Late afternoon is the hour for the fields if the rice is in. A crop calendar was not printed. Check on arrival. Do not budget this walk as a second museum, and do not treat the basin as the tea rows at Mộc Châu.

figures.caption: Rice in the Mường Thanh basin, with the hills on the far side
figures.alt: Green rice fields in the Mường Thanh basin and the hills beyond Điện Biên Phủ

gettingThere: The river and the fields are the center of the basin, in phường Điện Biên Phủ. From 1 July 2025 that ward includes the old Mường Thanh wards. A walk from a central hotel reaches the bridge, the walking street, and the monument hill. Minutes on foot were not printed. Check on arrival. A taxi fare inside the ward was not printed either.

legs.heading: From the basin ward
legs.body: On foot, in the center. The bridge, the walking street, and the view from Đồi D1 are the same ward. A published minute count for that loop is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hill D1
legs.body: The handbook’s view of the rice is from the monument hill. Walk down toward the Nậm Rốm and the bridge. Minutes for that descent were not printed. Check on arrival.

hours: Not a gated park. Late afternoon is the hour for the fields if the rice is in. A crop calendar is check on arrival.
closed: No weekly close was printed. Check on arrival if a park gate appears.
admissionNote: No ticket was printed for the river or the fields. Check on arrival only if a park gate appears. The relic point fee and the museum ticket are for those gates, not for this walk.
